summary: The audit checks the Honors in the Arts workshop in all three quarters of senior year (ARTSINST 201A, 201B and 201C, 2 to 5 units each, letter graded), with an A- or better in ARTSINST 201C, the honors project. You move in the three preparation courses and check the honors project and its critical framing by hand.
